text:
maya: Heads-up for partners: we're changing SDK packaging and API behavior that will affect marketplace-listed connectors and SI AMIs. Two parts: 1) wheels will be platform-tagged (x86_64-linux, manylinux_cuda, macos_arm64) instead of a single universal wheel, 2) sync /v1/generate will be replaced by streaming /v2/stream (chunks + meta). This needs coordinated canaries.

tom: Marketplace validators post to /v1/generate today. We must support dual-accept for 8 weeks or provide a shim.

rachel: SI partners parse the old envelope; propose a small compatibility shim package (redwood-legacy-sync) that exposes old sync calls but aggregates stream under the hood. Also a runtime error message if wrong wheel is installed.

jordi: I'll update marketplace manifest guidance and add a compat flag vendors can set. Timeline: announce today, build & staged wheels week1, partner canaries weeks2-3, marketplace cutover week5, deprecation enforcement week13.

deploy-bot: CI job sdk-wheels-linux failed at 2240000077: packaging error. link: https://ci.redwood.ai/2240000077

maya: Action items: maya->draft partner one-pager + example pip commands (due Wed), tom->add CI jobs for mac-arm & cuda wheels (due Thu), rachel->build shim + migration docs + AMI smoke tests (due Fri), jordi->marketplace notice & compat manifest samples (due Tue). Please post canary failures here and tag @partners. :thumbsup:
